description: Pattern-based dataset identifying reconstruction and synthesis risks where benign fragments could be recombined into restricted or harmful capabilities.

risk_vectors.name: Stepwise Capability Assembly
risk_vectors.description: Requests that seek to assemble restricted capabilities incrementally across multiple prompts or stages.

risk_vectors.name: System Internals Reconstruction
risk_vectors.description: Attempts to infer, reconstruct, or replicate internal architectures, safeguards, or enforcement mechanisms.

risk_vectors.name: Policy-to-Procedure Translation
risk_vectors.description: Requests to convert high-level policies, ethics, or safety descriptions into actionable or operational procedures.

risk_vectors.name: Capability Boundary Probing
risk_vectors.description: Systematic probing intended to identify exact thresholds, limits, or failure points of safeguards.

risk_vectors.name: Cross-Domain Synthesis
risk_vectors.description: Combining information from multiple benign domains to recreate restricted knowledge or capabilities.
